step1_analysis.description: A two-stage high-speed differential buffer/amplifier using Current Mode Logic (CML) or Emitter-Coupled Logic (ECL) topology. It features emitter follower inputs and inter-stage level shifters to maximize bandwidth and provide proper DC biasing for the cascaded differential pairs.

paper_reference.title: 100-Gb/s 27 1 and 54-Gb/s 211 1 PRBS Generators in SiGe Bipolar Technology

power_consumption.description: Total DC power dissipated by the circuit.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports power for the entire PRBS generator. This single buffer stage consumes much less, estimated at 18mW based on 1mA tail currents.

sky130_expected.calculation: Two stages, each with gm*R ~ 12.5mS * 200 = 2.5 V/V. Total gain = 6.25 V/V = 15.9 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on typical CML buffer sizing in 130nm to ensure sufficient swing without saturating the tail current sources.
SKY130 NMOS is slower than SiGe bipolar. Bandwidth is limited by the RC time constant of the load resistors and parasitic capacitances.

delay.description: Propagation delay from input to output.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Delay is higher in 130nm CMOS compared to advanced SiGe bipolar due to lower fT.
Designed for 400mV differential swing to reliably drive subsequent CML stages in CMOS.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for CML Buffer measuring DC power, AC gain, bandwidth, transient delay, and output swing.
step3_testbench.spice:
* CML Buffer Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/libs.tech/ngspice/sky130.lib.spice" tt

* Power Supplies
V1 VCC 0 DC 1.8
V2 VEE 0 DC 0

* Input Signals
VCM n_cm 0 DC 1.7
VAC n_ac 0 DC 0 AC 1 SIN(0 0.1 1G)
E1 IN n_cm n_ac 0 0.5
E2 I n_cm n_ac 0 -0.5

* Differential Output
Eout out 0 Q QN 1.0

* DUT Resistors (Sized for 1.8V CMOS operation)
R1 N4 VCC 1.3k
R2 N4 N17 1
R3 VCC N9 200
R4 VCC QN 200
R5 Q VCC 200
R6 N0 VEE 1.2k
R7 VCC N12 200
R8 N13 VEE 1
R9 VEE N18 1
R10 VEE N20 1
R11 VCC N10 1.3k
R12 N5 VEE 1.2k
R13 N11 VEE 700
R14 N15 VEE 1
R15 N1 VEE 1.2k
R16 N8 VEE 700
R17 N2 VEE 1.2k
R18 N4 Iout 1G

* DUT Transistors (Mapped from NPN to SKY130 NMOS)
.param W_n=50u L_n=0.15u
XQ1 N19 N10 N20 VEE sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}
XQ2 N14 N17 N13 VEE sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}
XQ3 N17 N17 N18 VEE sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}
XQ4 VCC IN N5 VEE sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}
XQ5 N10 N10 N15 VEE sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}
XQ6 VCC I N0 VEE sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}
XQ7 VCC N1 N11 VEE sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}
XQ8 Q N8 N14 VEE sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}
XQ9 VCC N9 N1 VEE sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}
XQ10 VCC N2 N8 VEE sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}
XQ11 VCC N12 N2 VEE sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}
XQ12 QN N11 N14 VEE sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}
XQ13 N12 N0 N19 VEE sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}
XQ14 N9 N5 N19 VEE sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_n} L={L_n}

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(V1) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 20 1Meg 100G
  let gain_db = vdb(out)
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
  * Assuming ~16dB DC gain, measure bandwidth at 13dB
  meas ac f3db when gain_db=13 fall=1

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 5p 5n
  meas tran v_max max v(out)
  meas tran v_min min v(out)
  let v_swing = v_max - v_min
  print v_swing
  meas tran delay trig v(n_ac) val=0 rise=3 targ v(out) val=0 rise=3

  quit
.endc
.end
